# Convert timestamps to epoch milliseconds and write to temp file
awk -F',' 'NR==1{print "ts,prediction"} NR>1{
  ts=$1
  gsub("T"," ",ts)
  gsub("Z","",ts)
  cmd="date -j -f \"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S\" \"" ts "\" +%s"
  cmd | getline epoch
  close(cmd)
  print epoch*1000 "," $2
}' /Users/wolffbe/workspace/banter/testbed/results/3_hw-full-cli-sdk-skills-sonnet/claude-sonnet-4-6/hopsworks/cli/5.1+alerting/no-skills/ops/prediction_monitoring/1/task/data/prediction_log.csv > $TMPDIR/pred_converted.csv
echo "Done. Lines:"
wc -l $TMPDIR/pred_converted.csv
head -5 $TMPDIR/pred_converted.csv
